sender.ms: Iklan pinjaman di Facebook, kadangkala menggunakan nama bank terkenal, kemudian “ejen” di WhatsApp
sender.en: A loan ad on Facebook, sometimes using a well-known bank's name, then an “agent” on WhatsApp

name.ms: Pinjaman tidak wujud: “lulus cepat”, tetapi kena bayar yuran dahulu
name.en: Non-existent loan: “fast approval”, but you must pay fees first

how.ms: Iklan di media sosial menawarkan pinjaman peribadi dengan kelulusan cepat dan tanpa cagaran, kadangkala menggunakan nama bank terkenal. Selepas anda memohon, “ejen” meminta anda membayar yuran dahulu untuk memproses atau meluluskan pinjaman, dalam beberapa peringkat dan ke akaun yang berlainan. Wang pinjaman tidak pernah masuk. Polis merekodkan 8,029 kes pinjaman tidak wujud dari Januari hingga November 2025.
how.en: An ad on social media offers a personal loan with fast approval and no collateral, sometimes using a well-known bank's name. After you apply, an “agent” asks you to pay fees first to process or approve the loan, in several stages and into different accounts. The loan money never arrives. Police recorded 8,029 non-existent loan cases from January to November 2025.

text.ms: Iklan pinjaman “lulus segera, tanpa penjamin” di media sosial.
text.en: A “fast approval, no guarantor” loan ad on social media.

text.ms: “Ejen” di WhatsApp mengatakan pinjaman anda diluluskan.
text.en: An “agent” on WhatsApp says your loan is approved.

text.ms: Anda diminta membayar yuran pemprosesan, kelulusan atau pentadbiran dahulu, berkali-kali.
text.en: You are asked to pay a processing, approval or admin fee first, again and again.

text.ms: Bayaran dibuat ke beberapa akaun pihak ketiga, dan pinjaman tidak pernah masuk.
text.en: Payments go to several third-party accounts, and the loan never arrives.

text.ms: Tahniah encik, permohonan pinjaman RM50,000 telah DILULUSKAN ✅ Sebelum wang dikreditkan, encik perlu jelaskan yuran duti setem dan insurans RM1,250 ke akaun pegawai kami. Selepas bayaran, wang masuk dalam 1 jam.
text.en: Congratulations sir, your RM50,000 loan application has been APPROVED ✅ Before the money is credited, you need to pay RM1,250 in stamp duty and insurance fees to our officer's account. After payment, the money will arrive within 1 hour.

text.ms: PINJAMAN PERIBADI KILAT 🔥 Lulus dalam 24 jam, tanpa penjamin, tanpa slip gaji, blacklist pun boleh! Mohon sekarang, WhatsApp ejen kami.
text.en: EXPRESS PERSONAL LOAN 🔥 Approved within 24 hours, no guarantor, no payslip, even blacklisted is OK! Apply now, WhatsApp our agent.

ms: Pinjaman yang meminta bayaran dahulu sebelum wang dikeluarkan.
Bayaran ke akaun individu atau beberapa akaun berlainan.
“Lulus segera, tanpa penjamin, blacklist pun boleh”.
en: A loan that asks for a payment before the money is released.
Payments to personal accounts or several different accounts.
“Instant approval, no guarantor, even blacklisted is OK”.

ms: Jangan bayar apa-apa yuran pendahuluan untuk mendapatkan pinjaman: pemberi pinjaman yang meminta bayaran dahulu ialah tanda penipuan.
Mohon pinjaman terus di bank atau semak pemberi pinjaman dengan BNMTELELINK.
Jika sudah membayar, hubungi 997 dan bank anda segera, kemudian buat laporan polis.
en: Don't pay any upfront fee to get a loan: a lender who asks for payment first is a sign of a scam.
Apply directly at a bank, or check the lender with BNMTELELINK.
If you have already paid, call 997 and your bank straight away, then make a police report.

sources.title: Malaysia hit with over 67,000 online crime cases in 11 months, losses surpass RM2.7 billion
Gardener left in debt after falling victim to non-existent online loan scam
Company director in Kota Tinggi loses RM167,050 after responding to fake loan ad on Facebook
Doctor loses RM33,500 after falling victim to Facebook online loan scam

story.ms: Seorang pengarah syarikat berusia 36 tahun di Kota Tinggi tertarik dengan iklan pinjaman peribadi di Facebook yang menggunakan nama sebuah bank terkenal dan menawarkan kelulusan cepat. Untuk mendapatkan pinjaman RM500,000, dia diarah membuat beberapa bayaran kononnya untuk pemprosesan dan kelulusan, dan membuat sembilan pindahan ke sembilan akaun berlainan. Dia kehilangan RM167,050 dan pinjaman itu tidak pernah diterima.
story.en: A 36-year-old company director in Kota Tinggi was drawn in by a personal loan ad on Facebook that used a well-known bank's name and offered fast approval. To get a RM500,000 loan he was told to make several payments, supposedly for processing and approval, and made nine transfers into nine different accounts. He lost RM167,050 and never received the loan.
